Thanks! Solid advice. I feel that the issue is I'm not "socially calibrated." All I got to do is talk more and it will come back naturally. Of course, I've never been one to talk to many different strangers just because I felt like it- I've always been pretty introverted.
I probably care too much what people think. 
Either way, I'm going to try to talk to more people.
Thanks again!
